### class `ValueStore`

Stores and replicates values across the DHT.

- **replicationFactor** (static field) — Number of nodes to replicate values to.
- **valueExpiry** (field) — How long before values expire.
- **store** (method) — Stores a value in the DHT with replication.

- **republishValues** (method) — Republishes all non-expired values to maintain replication.
  - chama: entries, difference, now, timestamp, value, add, key, _replicateValue, remove
- **incrementReplicationCount** (method) — Increments the replication count for a key.

### class `RateLimiter`

Token bucket rate limiter for controlling request throughput.

- **maxOperations** (field) — Maximum operations allowed per time window.
- **interval** (field) — Duration of the time window.
- **maxQueueSize** (field) — Maximum number of waiters allowed in the queue before FIFO eviction.
  - referenciado por (por nome): `lib/src/protocols/dht/rate_limiter.dart` (RateLimiter.fromConfig), `lib/src/transport/webtransport/webtransport_datagram.dart` (WebTransportDatagram.send), `lib/src/transport/webtransport/webtransport_datagram.dart` (WebTransportDatagram.trySend)
- **queueLength** (method) — Returns the current number of queued waiters.
  - chama: length
- **acquire** (method) — Acquires a permit, blocking if the rate limit is exceeded.
  - chama: RateLimitExceededError, now, difference, isNotEmpty, complete, removeAt, length, completeError, Completer, add, future
  - referenciado por (por nome): `lib/src/protocols/dht/kademlia_tree.dart` (KademliaTree.nodeLookup), `lib/src/protocols/dht/kademlia_tree.dart` (KademliaTree.storeValue), `lib/src/protocols/dht/kademlia_tree.dart` (KademliaTree.findValue)
- **release** (method) — Releases a permit, allowing queued operations to proceed.
  - chama: isNotEmpty, complete, removeAt
  - referenciado por (por nome): `lib/src/protocols/dht/kademlia_tree.dart` (KademliaTree.nodeLookup), `lib/src/protocols/dht/kademlia_tree.dart` (KademliaTree.storeValue), `lib/src/protocols/dht/kademlia_tree.dart` (KademliaTree.findValue)
- **fromConfig** (method) — Creates a [RateLimiter] from a [RateLimitConfig].
  - chama: RateLimiter, maxRequestsPerWindow, Duration, windowSeconds, hasMaxQueueSize, maxQueueSize

### class `PingHandler`

Handler for the libp2p Ping protocol (/ipfs/ping/1.0.0).

- **isStarted** (method) — Whether the handler has been started.

### class `PubSubConfig`

Configuration for Gossipsub v1.1.

- **protocolId** (field) — Primary Gossipsub protocol ID.
  - referenciado por (por nome): `lib/src/core/messages/message_factory.dart` (MessageFactory.createBaseMessage), `lib/src/protocols/pubsub/gossipsub/gossipsub_handler.dart` (GossipsubHandler.protocolId), `lib/src/protocols/pubsub/gossipsub/gossipsub_handler.dart` (GossipsubHandler.start)
- **fallbackProtocolId** (field) — Optional Gossipsub v1.0 protocol ID.
- **historyLength** (field) — Number of heartbeats worth of message IDs to advertise in IHAVE.
- **gossipFactor** (field) — Number of peers to gossip with per heartbeat (minimum).
- **d** (field) — Target topic mesh degree.
  - referenciado por (por nome): `lib/src/core/ipld/jose_cose_handler.dart` (JoseCoseHandler.encodeJWS)
- **dLow** (field) — Lower bound for mesh degree.
- **dHigh** (field) — Upper bound for mesh degree.
- **heartbeatIntervalMs** (field) — Heartbeat interval in milliseconds.
  - referenciado por (por nome): `lib/src/protocols/pubsub/gossipsub/gossipsub_handler.dart` (GossipsubHandler.start)
- **signMessages** (field) — Whether to sign outgoing messages.
- **strictSign** (field) — Whether to reject unsigned messages.
- **maxMessageSize** (field) — Maximum allowed message size in bytes.
  - referenciado por (por nome): `lib/src/core/validation/message_validator.dart` (MessageValidator.validateMessage), `lib/src/protocols/pubsub/gossipsub/gossipsub_handler.dart` (GossipsubHandler.publish)
- **topicScoreParams** (field) — Per-topic scoring parameters.
  - referenciado por (por nome): `lib/src/protocols/pubsub/gossipsub/gossipsub_handler.dart` (GossipsubHandler.start)
- **floodPublish** (field) — Whether to publish to all connected peers with acceptable score.
- **gossipRetransmission** (field) — Number of times to retransmit an IHAVE gossip entry.
- **maxIHaveLength** (field) — Maximum IHAVE message IDs to include per peer.
- **maxIWantLength** (field) — Maximum IWANT message IDs to request per peer.
- **pruneBackoffSeconds** (field) — Backoff period in seconds after being pruned from a mesh.
